reviews.title: is this app developed by someone’s father in his free time?
reviews.text: The articles are great, but the app is lacking basic features. There's no dark mode, no syncing across devices, and it doesn't even remember where you left off on the same device. For a paid subscription this is disappointing.

reviews.title: I like it but Search is annoying
reviews.text: I’m really into Physics and I love the “Recent” section but the magazines I don’t like so I tried search but you have to pay to search!? That’s just a rip-off But it’s good otherwise
